# LDAP reset clears form state and reports incomplete to the footer

setState resets the LDAP form then focuses the name field. resetState resets form values, replaces private basic state with blank names/host and port389, and emits bubbling config-updated completed:false; current later code also clears advanced values/view state. The Account Hub listener disables Forward from that Boolean. The new fixture tests directly assert name focus/clear and the incomplete event, plus validity/completeness after input and invalid host/port. They do not directly assert all reset fields or stale custom-validity/error-description cleanup. The current validation dependency contains an aria-described spelling for invalid name while other paths use aria-describedby, and reset does not explicitly clear error attributes/custom validity. Preserve that bounded accessibility/reset gap rather than claiming a complete validation reset or an LDAP connection result. No widget test, server or screen-reader run occurred.

Scope: Account Hub LDAP widget reset and tests.
